test_title: PYST 23: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 15 Mar 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

India is celebrating the 75th Azadi ka Amrit Mahotsava this year.

options.text: The 75th Azadi ka Amrit Mahotsava has been celebrated by India this year.
The 75th Azadi ka Amrit Mahotsava was celebrated by India this year.
This year India is being celebrated by the 75th Azadi ka Amrit Mahotsava.
The 75th Azadi ka Amrit Mahotsava is being celebrated by India this year.

solution:
The correct answer is** "The 75th Azadi ka Amrit Mahotsava is being celebrated by India this year."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The tense of given sentence is "**Present Continuous"**

 
 
• **​Active Voice (Present continuous) **Subject + am/is/are/ + Mainverb (ing form) + object 
 
• **Passive Voice (Present Continuous) **Object + am /is/are+ being + main verb (3rd form) + by + Subject.
 
• **"India"** is the Subject of the Sentence.
 
• **Celebrate** is the Main verb
 
• the 75th Azadi ka Amrit Mahotsava this year is the object.
 
• So according to the structure of the passive voice the correct answer is option no 4.
